description: A controller that binds the request, calls the service and builds the response, and holds no business rules.
A narrow interface that hides how courses are stored, so an in-memory class can later be replaced by a database one.
A record that carries the Bean Validation constraints of an incoming body, so invalid data never reaches the service.
A Spring base class for a controller advice that maps the framework's own exceptions to Problem Details.
A test annotated with WebMvcTest that loads only the web layer, with collaborators replaced by mocks.
A client value forced into an allowed range, such as a page size limited to 100, instead of being rejected.
